text: 你看见一个老妇人。
source_text: 你看见一个老妇人。

text: 你看见阿加莎。
source_text: 你看见阿加莎。

text: 这个女人头发灰白并且脸上布满皱纹，但步伐灵活，个性爽朗。
source_text: 这个女人头发灰白并且脸上布满皱纹，但步伐灵活，个性爽朗。

text: 你是一个坏人。我不会和你有什么关系。
source_text: 你是一个坏人。我不会和你有什么关系。

text: 我们的年轻人被威胁，实在糟透了。失去坦蒂也是件可怕的事。
source_text: 我们的年轻人被威胁，实在糟透了。失去坦蒂也是件可怕的事。

text: 哼~~嗯。
source_text: 哼~~嗯。

text: 好吧。
source_text: 好吧。

text: 为什么？
source_text: 为什么？

text: 什么意思？
source_text: 什么意思？

text: 我知道你会尽力的，亲爱的。找到坦蒂，帮她逃出那些野蛮人的魔掌，让她回到亚拉德什身边。你会帮这个小镇一个大忙，好人也会有好报。
source_text: 我知道你会尽力的，亲爱的。找到坦蒂，帮她逃出那些野蛮人的魔掌，让她回到亚拉德什身边。你会帮这个小镇一个大忙，好人也会有好报。

text: 亚拉德什很爱他的女儿。也正是这股爱使这个男人成为这个镇的支柱。失去这种爱，他会迷茫，并且沙荫镇肯定也会随之如此……
source_text: 亚拉德什很爱他的女儿。也正是这股爱使这个男人成为这个镇的支柱。失去这种爱，他会迷茫，并且沙荫镇肯定也会随之如此……

text: 我会尽力的。再见。
source_text: 我会尽力的。再见。

text: 我很想帮忙。
source_text: 我很想帮忙。

text: 嗯……再见。
source_text: 嗯……再见。

text: 我觉的她被关起来了。她是仇恨的目标。这种仇恨在东南方非常强烈。我肯定你能在那里找到她。祝你好运。
source_text: 我觉的她被关起来了。她是仇恨的目标。这种仇恨在东南方非常强烈。我肯定你能在那里找到她。祝你好运。

text: 谢谢。
source_text: 谢谢。

text: 你没听说吗？坦蒂失踪了。我觉得她被绑架了。亚拉德什忧心如焚。真是一件可怕的事……
source_text: 你没听说吗？坦蒂失踪了。我觉得她被绑架了。亚拉德什忧心如焚。真是一件可怕的事……

text: 听说你救了坦蒂。你做得很好。你的命很硬。我感觉你的未来很有希望。
source_text: 听说你救了坦蒂。你做得很好。你的命很硬。我感觉你的未来很有希望。

text: 我对坦蒂的事很遗憾。她是一个那么有朝气的姑娘。她应该活得更好。
source_text: 我对坦蒂的事很遗憾。她是一个那么有朝气的姑娘。她应该活得更好。

text: 你好。你一定就是那个所有人都在谈论的外地人。【阿加莎叹息】 我有什么能帮你吗？
source_text: 你好。你一定就是那个所有人都在谈论的外地人。【阿加莎叹息】 我有什么能帮你吗？

text: 嗯。
source_text: 嗯。

text: 你是谁？
source_text: 你是谁？

text: 你看起来很疲倦。这里出了什么问题吗？
source_text: 你看起来很疲倦。这里出了什么问题吗？

text: 为什么你看起来这么疲倦？
source_text: 为什么你看起来这么疲倦？

text: 别跟我说，老女人。
source_text: 别跟我说，老女人。

text: 你需要的帮助超出了我的能力，我的孩子。愿达玛与你同在。
source_text: 你需要的帮助超出了我的能力，我的孩子。愿达玛与你同在。

text: 我的名字是阿加莎. 我是沙荫镇的说书人。我的工作就是记录历史，让大家记住并且永不遗忘。
source_text: 我的名字是阿加莎. 我是沙荫镇的说书人。我的工作就是记录历史，让大家记住并且永不遗忘。

text: 给我讲一个故事。
source_text: 给我讲一个故事。

text: 好吧，随便。
source_text: 好吧，随便。

text: 能不遗忘真好。
source_text: 能不遗忘真好。

text: 我很抱歉，孩子。我现在很疲倦。我需要休息。请过会儿再来。
source_text: 我很抱歉，孩子。我现在很疲倦。我需要休息。请过会儿再来。

text: 千真万确。【阿加莎盯了你一会儿。】 对于年轻人记住历史是好事，但是要在历史的洪流里扮演一个角色却是非常困难的。有些时候，我们所走的路在很久以前就已经就被某些事情所决定了。愿达玛与你同在。我必须休息一小会儿了。过会儿再来，当我有气力时，我们再谈。
source_text: 千真万确。【阿加莎盯了你一会儿。】 对于年轻人记住历史是好事，但是要在历史的洪流里扮演一个角色却是非常困难的。有些时候，我们所走的路在很久以前就已经就被某些事情所决定了。愿达玛与你同在。我必须休息一小会儿了。过会儿再来，当我有气力时，我们再谈。

text: 谢谢你提到这点。我已经很老了，这就是为什么。我不能在晚上入睡。当我合上我的眼睛……【阿加莎停了一下。】但是我就是不能睡着。请你理解，我已经是一把老骨头的人了……
source_text: 谢谢你提到这点。我已经很老了，这就是为什么。我不能在晚上入睡。当我合上我的眼睛……【阿加莎停了一下。】但是我就是不能睡着。请你理解，我已经是一把老骨头的人了……

text: 我很抱歉，我非常疲倦。请你过会儿再来好吗？
source_text: 我很抱歉，我非常疲倦。请你过会儿再来好吗？

text: 再见。
source_text: 再见。

text: 好吧。
source_text: 好吧。

text: 为什么你这么疲倦？
source_text: 为什么你这么疲倦？

text: 我在晚上没有睡好，我的孩子。一定是因为我太老了。
source_text: 我在晚上没有睡好，我的孩子。一定是因为我太老了。

text: 你好，我的孩子。你看起来不错。你让我想起了我的小孩。
source_text: 你好，我的孩子。你看起来不错。你让我想起了我的小孩。

text: 嗯。
source_text: 嗯。

text: 那么，我想听一个故事。
source_text: 那么，我想听一个故事。

text: 我很高兴你感觉好点了。
source_text: 我很高兴你感觉好点了。

text: 谢谢。再见。
source_text: 谢谢。再见。

text: 你确实让我想起了我自己的小孩。当她只有几个月大时，实在是像极了。
source_text: 你确实让我想起了我自己的小孩。当她只有几个月大时，实在是像极了。

text: 谢谢你。达玛总是说，旺季过后，种下礼貌的农夫会更好过。
source_text: 谢谢你。达玛总是说，旺季过后，种下礼貌的农夫会更好过。

text: 请给我讲一个故事。
source_text: 请给我讲一个故事。

text: 这个达玛的家伙听起来像个傻瓜。
source_text: 这个达玛的家伙听起来像个傻瓜。

text: 你侮辱了你的长辈。你应该更清楚这点。
source_text: 你侮辱了你的长辈。你应该更清楚这点。

text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see an aged woman.
source_text: You see an aged woman.

text: You see 阿加莎.
source_text: You see 阿加莎.

text: This woman is wrinkled and gray, yet has a spry step and a bright personality.
source_text: This woman is wrinkled and gray, yet has a spry step and a bright personality.

text: You are a bad person. I will have nothing to do with you.
source_text: You are a bad person. I will have nothing to do with you.

text: It is a terrible thing when our youth are threatened. The loss of 坦蒂 would be a terrible thing.
source_text: It is a terrible thing when our youth are threatened. The loss of 坦蒂 would be a terrible thing.

text: Hnng.
source_text: Hnng.

text: Okay.
source_text: Okay.

text: Why?
source_text: Why?

text: What do you mean?
source_text: What do you mean?

text: I know you will do your best, dearie. Find 坦蒂, help her escape those beasts and return her to 亚拉德什. You will do this community a favor and build good karma as well.
source_text: I know you will do your best, dearie. Find 坦蒂, help her escape those beasts and return her to 亚拉德什. You will do this community a favor and build good karma as well.

text: 亚拉德什 loves his daughter very much. It is that love that makes him the man that he is and a pillar of this community. Without that love he would be lost, and 沙荫镇 would surely follow . . .
source_text: 亚拉德什 loves his daughter very much. It is that love that makes him the man that he is and a pillar of this community. Without that love he would be lost, and 沙荫镇 would surely follow . . .

text: I will do my best. Goodbye.
source_text: I will do my best. Goodbye.

text: I could use some help.
source_text: I could use some help.

text: Hmmm. We'll see.
source_text: Hmmm. We'll see.

text: I feel that she is imprisoned. She was the target of hatred. That hate is very strong to the southeast. I'm sure you will find her there. Good luck.
source_text: I feel that she is imprisoned. She was the target of hatred. That hate is very strong to the southeast. I'm sure you will find her there. Good luck.

text: Thank you.
source_text: Thank you.

text: You have not heard? 坦蒂 is missing. I feel she was kidnapped. 亚拉德什 is most distraught. This is a terrible thing . . .
source_text: You have not heard? 坦蒂 is missing. I feel she was kidnapped. 亚拉德什 is most distraught. This is a terrible thing . . .

text: I hear that you have saved 坦蒂. That was the right thing to do. Your karma is strong. I have high hopes for your future.
source_text: I hear that you have saved 坦蒂. That was the right thing to do. Your karma is strong. I have high hopes for your future.

text: I'm very sorry to hear about 坦蒂. She was such a bright young woman. She would have done good with her life.
source_text: I'm very sorry to hear about 坦蒂. She was such a bright young woman. She would have done good with her life.

text: Hello. You must be the stranger everyone is talking about. 【阿加莎 sighs.】 How can I help you?
source_text: Hello. You must be the stranger everyone is talking about. 【阿加莎 sighs.】 How can I help you?

text: Hngh.
source_text: Hngh.

text: Who are you?
source_text: Who are you?

text: You look very tired. Is there anything wrong?
source_text: You look very tired. Is there anything wrong?

text: Why do you look so tired?
source_text: Why do you look so tired?

text: Don't talk to me, old woman.
source_text: Don't talk to me, old woman.

text: You need more help than I can give you, child. May 达玛 be with you.
source_text: You need more help than I can give you, child. May 达玛 be with you.

text: My name is 阿加莎. I am the storyteller of 沙荫镇. It is my job # to keep the history so that we may remember and never forget.
source_text:
My name is 阿加莎. I am the storyteller of 沙荫镇. It is my job
 # to keep the history so that we may remember and never forget.

text: Tell me a story.
source_text: Tell me a story.

text: Okay, whatever.
source_text: Okay, whatever.

text: It is good not to forget.
source_text: It is good not to forget.

text: I'm sorry, child, I am tired right now. I need my rest. Please come # back later.
source_text:
I'm sorry, child, I am tired right now. I need my rest. Please come
 # back later.

text: How very true. 【阿加莎 stares at you for a moment.】 It is good for # the young to remember, but it is very hard to act within the flow of history. # Sometimes, the very course we take is determined by events long ago. May 达玛 # be with you. I must rest for a little while. Come back again, when I am stronger, # and we will speak again.
source_text:
How very true. 【阿加莎 stares at you for a moment.】 It is good for
 # the young to remember, but it is very hard to act within the flow of history.
 # Sometimes, the very course we take is determined by events long ago. May 达玛
 # be with you. I must rest for a little while. Come back again, when I am stronger,
 # and we will speak again.

text: Thank you for asking. I'm just old, that's all. I cannot sleep at night. # I close my eyes . . . 【阿加莎 pauses.】 But I get no rest. Please, it is # just my old tired bones . . .
source_text:
Thank you for asking. I'm just old, that's all. I cannot sleep at night.
 # I close my eyes . . . 【阿加莎 pauses.】 But I get no rest. Please, it is
 # just my old tired bones . . .

text: I'm sorry, I'm very tired. Could you please come back later?
source_text: I'm sorry, I'm very tired. Could you please come back later?

text: Baba.
source_text: Baba.

text: Okay.
source_text: Okay.

text: Why are you so tired?
source_text: Why are you so tired?

text: I don't sleep well at night, my child. It must be my age.
source_text: I don't sleep well at night, my child. It must be my age.

text: Good day, my child. You look well. You remind me of my own baby.
source_text: Good day, my child. You look well. You remind me of my own baby.

text: Hng.
source_text: Hng.

text: I want a story, then.
source_text: I want a story, then.

text: I'm glad you are feeling better.
source_text: I'm glad you are feeling better.

text: Thank you. Goodbye.
source_text: Thank you. Goodbye.

text: You definitely remind me of my baby. When she was just a few months # old, as a matter of fact.
source_text:
You definitely remind me of my baby. When she was just a few months
 # old, as a matter of fact.

text: Thank you. 达玛 always said that the farmer who plants politeness will # walk easy when the season is over.
source_text:
Thank you. 达玛 always said that the farmer who plants politeness will
 # walk easy when the season is over.

text: Please tell me a story.
source_text: Please tell me a story.

text: This 达玛 fellow sounds like an idiot.
source_text: This 达玛 fellow sounds like an idiot.

text: You insult your elders. You should know better.
source_text: You insult your elders. You should know better.
